user.title: GC Monitor
user.description: Measure garbage collector pauses and freeze long-lived objects after startup.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.

data_description.refreeze_hours: Thaw, collect and freeze again every N hours. 0 turns the interval off. Each run pauses Home Assistant once for the length of a full collection.

refreeze.name: Refreeze
refreeze.description: Thaws the frozen objects, runs one full collection and freezes the survivors again. Pauses Home Assistant once for the length of a full collection.
